description: React component for a post reminder submenu in Mattermost, allowing users to set reminders with options like 30 mins, 1 hour, 2 hours, tomorrow, or custom time, including modal interactions and time calculations.

classes.name: PostReminderSubmenu
classes.description: React functional component rendering a submenu for setting post reminders with various time options.

methods.name: handlePostReminderMenuClick
methods.description: Handles click events for reminder options, opening modal for custom time or dispatching reminder with calculated end time.
